guard: a manager reminting daemon credentials accepts a store-identity answer only from the process the reload store certified, so a second holder of a copied delivery credential cannot echo the live lease holder and be believed
why: The rail is queue-grouped, so the reply is whatever some responder chose to send. The previous
round compared the reply's responder field against the lease holder, which a second responder
reads as easily as the manager does. These mutations aim at the two signatures that replace that
comparison: the challenge signature over the answer, and the reload-store certificate over the
process key. Removing either one restores a forgery the real-manager suite reproduces end to end.

mutations.name: M1 the challenge signature is accepted without verifying it
mutations.replace: try { return raw.sig !== undefined && publicKey !== undefined; }
mutations.note: A copied delivery credential signs the answer with its own key. Without the verification the manager classifies the forger's store as its own and remints on a process that reloads nothing.
mutations.command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build > /dev/null && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/manager build > /dev/null && pnpm smoke:manager-two-root-renewal
mutations.expectRed: a copied delivery credential echoing the live holder is refused at least once

mutations.name: M2 the lease process key is taken without its reload-store certificate
mutations.note: The delivery credential can write the lease, so an uncertified process key is a key the attacker chose. Without the certificate check the lease attests to itself.
mutations.expectRed: attacker self-certifies with a foreign store key

mutations.name: M3 the challenge is not bound to the request
mutations.find: if (p.space !== space || p.caller !== caller || p.challenge !== challenge || p.incarnation !== lease.incarnation)
mutations.replace: if (p.space !== space || p.caller !== caller || p.incarnation !== lease.incarnation)
mutations.note: A replayed proof from an earlier pass would otherwise answer a fresh challenge.
